# Cambridge Dictionary

> A comprehensive online dictionary, thesaurus, and translation platform providing English definitions, multilingual translations, grammar reference, and interactive learning tools.

Cambridge Dictionary offers free access to multiple English dictionary variants (learner, essential, standard) across British and American English, supported by the Cambridge English Corpus. The platform includes premium features through Cambridge Dictionary +Plus, interactive games, pronunciation guides, and bilingual dictionaries for major languages including Chinese, Danish, and French.

## Core Dictionary Resources

- [Cambridge Dictionary Homepage](https://dictionary.cambridge.org): Homepage for Cambridge Dictionary with English definitions, translations, and thesaurus tools
- [Cambridge English Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english): Cambridge English Dictionary with word definitions, pronunciations, and translations
- [Cambridge Learner's Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/learner-english): Cambridge Learner's Dictionary for intermediate learners with British English focus
- [Cambridge Essential British English Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/essential-british-english): Cambridge Essential British English Dictionary for beginner-level vocabulary reference
- [Cambridge Essential American English Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/essential-american-english): Cambridge Essential American English Dictionary for beginner-level American English
- [Dictionary Access Hub](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary): Main dictionary access page with multiple dictionary variants and language learning resources

## Translation & Thesaurus Tools

- [Cambridge Translator](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/translate): Free online translation tool supporting 19 languages with dictionary integration
- [Cambridge Thesaurus](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/thesaurus): Cambridge Thesaurus with synonyms, antonyms, and usage examples in British/American English

## Bilingual Dictionaries

- [English–Chinese (Simplified) Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-chinese-simplified): Bilingual English-Mandarin Chinese dictionary with translation and example sentences
- [Chinese (Simplified)–English Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/chinese-simplified-english): Bilingual Mandarin Chinese-English dictionary for IELTS and exam preparation
- [English–Chinese (Traditional) Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-chinese-traditional): Bilingual English-Traditional Chinese dictionary with vocabulary reference
- [Chinese (Traditional)–English Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/chinese-traditional-english): Bilingual Traditional Chinese-English dictionary for exam preparation
- [English–Danish Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-danish): Bilingual English-Danish dictionary with vocabulary lookup and example sentences

## Grammar & Pronunciation Reference

- [English Grammar Today](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar): English Grammar Today reference guide with British English grammar rules and explanations
- [Pronunciation Guide](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation): Audio pronunciation guide with British and American English phonetic transcriptions

## Learning & Interactive Features

- [Cambridge Dictionary +Plus](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/plus): Premium subscription service with vocabulary quizzes, word lists, and interactive learning
- [Games Hub](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/games): Games Hub for English vocabulary practice with daily challenges and mobile games

## Account & Support

- [My Profile](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/auth/profile): User profile page for Cambridge Dictionary +Plus account management and settings
- [Cambridge Dictionary +Plus Help](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/howto.html): Help guide for Cambridge Dictionary +Plus with tutorials on word lists and quizzes
